## About the study

The long-run outlook for corn ethanol is uncertain as the vehicle fleet shifts toward electric and hybrid cars. Sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), a key component of the U.S. plan to reach net-zero aviation emissions by 2050, could open a new market for ethanol, but its size depends on policy choices such as how the carbon intensity of ethanol-based SAF is measured and whether it qualifies for tax credits.

## Objective

Quantify the market and welfare effects of using corn ethanol to produce sustainable aviation fuel in the United States.
